Bettina Kroll, the draft to June Osei-Lark is saved in the mailbox with the subject "PHL label cleanup". Nothing has been sent.

It has Sofia's bullets, plus your two lines: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. It also mentions PD-4821 and is signed from you.

I couldn't tell from the digest whether the saved report has been relabeled since 18 May. The draft doesn't say either way, so you may want to check before sending.
